name: mis233-grafana
description: MIS 233 final project by Zeynep Sudem: two Grafana panel plugins, a data source plugin and a mock REST/WebSocket API.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix zeynepsudem-insight-panel install && npm --prefix zeynepsudem-heatmap-panel install && npm --prefix zeynepsudem-campus-datasource install
scripts.build: npm --prefix zeynepsudem-insight-panel run build && npm --prefix zeynepsudem-heatmap-panel run build && npm --prefix zeynepsudem-campus-datasource run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix zeynepsudem-insight-panel run test:ci && npm --prefix zeynepsudem-heatmap-panel run test:ci && npm --prefix zeynepsudem-campus-datasource run test:ci && npm --prefix mock-api test
